name: Customer support (L1/L2)
description: Inbound support tickets, FAQs, status checks, refunds, basic troubleshooting.
pilotMetric: % of L1 tickets resolved without human touch

name: Sales operations & lead enrichment
description: Lead scoring, CRM hygiene, account research, follow-up drafting.
exampleTasks: Enrich inbound leads from a name + email

name: Content & marketing ops
description: Drafting, repurposing across channels, scheduling, basic SEO research.
exampleTasks: Repurpose a long-form post into 8 channel-specific assets
pilotMetric: Hours/week reclaimed at same publish cadence

name: Bookkeeping & finance ops
description: Transaction categorization, AR/AP follow-ups, monthly close prep, simple reporting.

name: Recruiting & resume screening
description: Resume parsing, ICP-fit scoring, initial outreach, interview scheduling.
exampleTasks: Score inbound applications against a rubric
Draft personalized outreach to passive candidates
pilotMetric: Time from application to first interview

name: Inbound qualification & demo booking
description: Web-form responses, calendar booking, basic discovery, routing to the right human.
exampleTasks: Book a demo on the right person's calendar

name: Internal knowledge & onboarding
description: Internal Q&A over SOPs and docs, new-hire onboarding, finding the right slack thread.
exampleTasks: Answer 'how do we do X' from internal docs
Onboard a new hire through a 2-week curriculum

name: Data entry & cross-system admin
description: Copy-paste between systems, form filling, basic reconciliation, report assembly.
exampleTasks: Move data between CRM and billing
Assemble a weekly metrics doc from 4 dashboards
